name: Lau ca dua
summary: Lẩu cá dứa nấu măng chua is a southern sour-sweet hotpot of sea catfish and bamboo shoot. The flesh is sweet, the skin is smooth and fatty, and you finish the fish with nước mắm, chili, and a little bún.
origin: Can Gio. On 2 Oct 2022 it sits on đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất in the old Cần Thạnh town, now xã Cần Giờ.
howToEat: Share the pot. When it boils, take a piece of fish into nước mắm with chili, and add bún and some of the broth.
Other pots beside it: lẩu cá ngát, cá bóp, cá mao, cá đuối, and cá chẽm, cooked with vegetables, sour bamboo, cần cà, or ngót.
About 280,000–300,000 VND for a hotpot portion on 2 Oct 2022.
where: Đường Duyên Hải, then đường Tắc Xuất toward the sea, in xã Cần Giờ. No shop is named.
seoTitle: Lau ca dua — sour bamboo hotpot in Can Gio
seoDescription: Lẩu cá dứa nấu măng chua is a sour-sweet sea-catfish hotpot with bamboo shoot, sweet flesh, and a smooth fatty skin.
texture: The flesh is sweet and the skin is smooth and fatty.
taste: The broth is southern, sour-sweet, and full.
